prompt: A shopping cart maps product ids to quantities, and each quantity is adjusted on its own. Which structure fits best?
explanation: A hash maps each product id to its quantity, so HSET and HINCRBY adjust one product at a time and HGET reads a single line of the cart. A sorted set would force a re-score on every quantity change and orders by quantity, which the cart does not need.

options.text: A hash keyed by product id, holding quantities as field values
A list of product ids in the order they were added
A sorted set of product ids scored by quantity
